|---:|---|
| 0 | idle |
| 1 | running-right / walk / drag |
| 2 | running-left |
| 3 | "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"waving / welcome / celebrate |
| 4 | jumping / play |
| 5 | failed / error / disappointed |
| 6 | wa"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"iting |
| 7 | running / working |
| 8 | review / think |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> 如果你手里只有一堆单行动作 sheet（不是 atlas），也支持——见下方"素材两种形式"。"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 2. 在 `lib/assets/manifest.json` 增加角色"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"在 `characters` 下加一个 key："},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**必备 15 状态一个都不能少**：`idle / working / celebrate / error / disappointed / joy / eat / play / drag / wa"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"lk / sleep / wake / welcome / think / wait`。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"上面的 atlas 行映射是通用模板，直接复制改角色 id 即可跑起来。想让某个状态换动作（例如 `eat` 走单独的表情），改对应条目的 `row` 或 `sheet` 即可。"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"想把新角色作为默认，把顶层的 `"default": "jingyu-zongcai"` 改成 `"my-cat"`。"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### 3. 校验并重装"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"门禁会告诉你缺哪个状态、sheet 文件不存在、frames/fps 不合法等——按报错逐条修就行。"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 素材两种形式"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Codex atlas 行**（推荐）：`{ "sheet": "spritesheet.webp", "row": 0, "rows": 9, "frames": 8, "fps": 4, "},{"id":"p30s2","text":""playback": "loop" }`
- **单行动作 sheet**：`{ "sheet": "idle.png", "frames": 3, "fps": 4, "playback": "l"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ck": "loop" }`
- **单行动作 sheet**：`{ "sheet": "idle.png", "frames": 3, "fps": 4, "playback": "loop" }`"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 字段速查"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| 字段 | 说明 |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| `sheet` | 相对 `lib/assets/characters/<id>/` 的文件名。允许 `.png / .webp / .svg / .jpg / .jpeg / .gif / .j"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"son` |

| `row` / `row"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"s` | atlas 行索引与总行数；`row < rows` |

| `motion` | 可选运动配方：`bob / wiggle / squash / shake / sigh / hop / tilt / flo"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"at / wave`。**要求 `frames === 1`**（`error` 是唯一例外，可以多帧 + 运动叠加） |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## 开发"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`lib/client.js` 是构建产物，改 `lib/client/index.mjs` 后运行 `node scripts/build-client.mjs` 重新生成。"}],"truncated":false}
